issue.title: A workspace whose launch preparation refused on nested preservation stays assignable, so every later launch there fails in seconds

task_type_fields.impact:
One unpreservable leftover poisons a workspace slot for every later agent until a human
cleans it up. Each victim burns its queue wait (bob-cli-do.4 waited 53 min) and its bead
claim, and surfaces as an unrelated-looking FAILED agent. Fail-closed preservation is
correct. What is missing is remembering the refusal: skip or quarantine that workspace
for new launches, and raise one actionable notification naming the nested repo and its
dirty paths, instead of failing agent after agent.
task_type_fields.repro:
Observed 2026-10-28 in project gh_bobs-org__bob-cli. A nested clone at
`<workspace>/sase/repos/external/projects/sase` held a 13-line uncommitted diff left by
`bob-cli-df.land--code`. Launch-time nested preservation
(`prepare_launch_workspace_repos` -> `preserve_nested_repositories`) refused with a
`PreservationError` (the verified-snapshot 64 MiB cap; the root cause is tracked
separately by the thin-snapshot plan). That raises `WorkspacePreparationError(step="sidecar-protection",
reclone_eligible=False)`. The runner releases the workspace as a final setup failure
(`_is_workspace_preparation_failure` in `src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_launch.py`). The
next launch is then assigned the same workspace and fails the same way about 5 s after
admission:

- bob-cli_11: `gh_bobs-org__bob-cli_ace-run-261028_071347`, `..._091526`, `..._091809`
- bob-cli_10: bob-cli-dp.1 (`261028_112530`), bob-cli-do.4 (`261028_104757`)

Repro: in a numbered workspace, leave a dirty nested repo that `snapshot_git_repo`
refuses (for example, monkeypatch `SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES` to a few bytes). Launch two agents
in sequence. Both fail in preparation, and nothing records the refusal or steers the
second launch to another workspace.

issue.creation_reason:
Found while triaging the bob-cli-do.4 launch failure. The snapshot cap bug is being fixed
separately. This cascade is independent: any future non-reclone-eligible preservation
refusal will fail every later agent assigned to that workspace.

Focused verification passed: 88 Python tests across slot refusal, allocator, maintenance, and nested preservation; Rust allocator skip tests passed (3); core refusal policy and Python binding unit tests passed.
